verses.en: Hear, O ye heavens, and give ear, O earth, and rejoice ye inhabitants thereof, for the Lord is God, and beside him there is no Savior.
verses.sm: Faalogo maia, E outou le lagi e, ma ua’i mai taliga, E le lalolagi e, ma olioli outou o e ua aumau ai, ona o le Alii o le Atua, ma e ese mai ai o ia ua leai se Faaola.

verses.en: Great is his wisdom, marvelous are his ways, and the extent of his doings none can find out.
verses.sm: Ua tele lava lona poto, ua ofoofogia lava ona ala, ma o le lautele o ana mea e fai e leai sē e mafai ona iloaina.

verses.en: His purposes fail not, neither are there any who can stay his hand.
verses.sm: E lē mafai ona i’uvale ona faamoemoe, pe i ai se tasi e mafai ona taofia lona aao.

verses.en: From eternity to eternity he is the same, and his years never fail.
verses.sm: Ua tutusa o ia mai le faavavau i le faavavau, ma e lē i’u lava ona tausaga.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord—I, the Lord, am merciful and gracious unto those who fear me, and delight to honor those who serve me in righteousness and in truth unto the end.
verses.sm: Auā ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii— o A’u, o le Alii, ou te alofa mutimutivale ma agalelei ia te i latou o e e matata’u mai ia te a’u, ma fiafia e faamamalu i latou o e e auauna mai ia te a’u i le amiotonu ma le upumoni e oo i le iuga.

verses.en: Great shall be their reward and eternal shall be their glory.
verses.sm: O le a tele lava lo latou taui ma o le a faavavau lo latou mamalu.

verses.en: And to them will I reveal all mysteries, yea, all the hidden mysteries of my kingdom from days of old, and for ages to come, will I make known unto them the good pleasure of my will concerning all things pertaining to my kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o le a Ou faaali atu i ai mealilo uma, ioe, mealilo natia uma o lo’u malo mai aso anamua, ma tausaga e oo mai, o le a Ou faailoa atu ia te i latou le fiafia lelei o lo’u loto e uiga i mea uma e faatatau i lo’u malo.

verses.en: Yea, even the wonders of eternity shall they know, and things to come will I show them, even the things of many generations.
verses.sm: Ioe, e oo i mea ofoofogia o le faavavau o le a latou iloa, ma o mea o le a oo mai o le a Ou faaali atu ia te i latou, o mea lava ia o tupulaga e tele.

verses.en: And their wisdom shall be great, and their understanding reach to heaven; and before them the wisdom of the wise shall perish, and the understanding of the prudent shall come to naught.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tele lava lo latou poto, ma tau i le lagi lo latou malamalama; ma o le a fano i o latou luma le poto o e e atamamai, ma o le malamalama o e e faautauta o le a avea ma meanoa.

verses.en: For by my Spirit will I enlighten them, and by my power will I make known unto them the secrets of my will—yea, even those things which eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor yet entered into the heart of man.
verses.sm: Auā o lo’u Agaga o le a Ou faamalamalamaina ai i latou, ma o lo’u mana o le a Ou faailoa atu ai ia te i latou mealilo o lo’u loto— ioe, e oo lava i mea e lei vaaia e mata, pe ua faalogoina e taliga, pe ua ulu ifo i totonu o le loto o le tagata.

verses.en: We, Joseph Smith, Jun., and Sidney Rigdon, being in the Spirit on the sixteenth day of February, in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and thirty-two—
verses.sm: O ma’ua, o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Sini Rikitone, ina o ma i ai i le Agaga i le aso sefulu ono o Fepuari, i le tausaga o lo tatou Alii e tasi le afe valu selau ma le tolusefulu-lua—

verses.en: By the power of the Spirit our eyes were opened and our understandings were enlightened, so as to see and understand the things of God—
verses.sm: Sa tatalaina o ma’ua mata ma faapupulaina o ma’ua malamalamaaga e le mana o le Agaga, ina ia mafai ona vaai ma malamalama i mea a le Atua—

verses.en: Even those things which were from the beginning before the world was, which were ordained of the Father, through his Only Begotten Son, who was in the bosom of the Father, even from the beginning;
verses.sm: O mea lava ia sa mai i le amataga ae le’i i ai le lalolagi, o mea sa faauuina e le Tamā, e ala i lona Atalii Pele e Toatasi, o lē sa i le finagalo o le Tamā, mai lava i le amataga;

w.en: to the will of the Father

verses.en: Of whom we bear record; and the record which we bear is the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ, who is the Son, whom we saw and with whom we conversed in the heavenly vision.
verses.sm: O lē ma te molimau atu ai; ma o le mau ma te molimau atu o le atoatoaga lea o le talalelei a Iesu Keriso, o lē o le Alo, o lē na ma vaai i ai ma lē na matou fetautalatalaa’i i le faaaliga vaaia faalelagi.

verses.en: For while we were doing the work of translation, which the Lord had appointed unto us, we came to the twenty-ninth verse of the fifth chapter of John, which was given unto us as follows—
verses.sm: Auā a’o ma faia le galuega o le faaliliuga, lea na tofia mai e le Alii ia te i ma’ua, sa ma oo mai i le fuaiupu luasefulu-iva o le mataupu e lima o le Ioane, lea sa tuuina mai ia te i ma’ua e faapea—

verses.en: Speaking of the resurrection of the dead, concerning those who shall hear the voice of the Son of Man:
verses.sm: O loo tautala e uiga i le toetutu mai o e ua oti, e faatatau ia te i latou o e o le a faalogo i le siufofoga o le Atalii o le Tagata:

verses.en: And shall come forth; they who have done good, in the resurrection of the just; and they who have done evil, in the resurrection of the unjust.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tutula’i mai; o i latou o e na faia mea lelei, i le toetutu mai o e amiotonu; ma o i latou o e na faia mea leaga, i le toetutu mai o e amioletonu.

verses.en: Now this caused us to marvel, for it was given unto us of the Spirit.
verses.sm: O lenei mea na oo mai ai ia te i ma’ua le ofo, auā sa tuuina mai ia te i ma’ua e le Agaga.

verses.en: And while we meditated upon these things, the Lord touched the eyes of our understandings and they were opened, and the glory of the Lord shone round about.
verses.sm: Ma a’o ma manatunatu loloto i nei mea, sa pa’i mai le Alii i mata o o ma’ua malamalamaaga ma sa tatalaina, ma sa susulu faataamilo mai le mamalu o le Alii.

verses.en: And we beheld the glory of the Son, on the right hand of the Father, and received of his fulness;
verses.sm: Ma sa ma vaaia le mamalu o le Alo, i le aao taumatau o le Tamā, ma sa maua lona atoatoa;

verses.en: And saw the holy angels, and them who are sanctified before his throne, worshiping God, and the Lamb, who worship him forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma sa ma vaai I agelu paia, ma I latou o e ua faapaiaina I luma o lona nofoaalii, o loo tapuai atu I le Atua, ma le Tamai Mamoe, o e ua tapuai atu ia te ia e faavavau, faavavau lava.

verses.en: And now, after the many testimonies which have been given of him, this is the testimony, last of all, which we give of him: That he lives!
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua mavae le tele o molimau ua tuuina mai e uiga ia te ia, o le molimau mulimuli lenei, I molimau uma, ma te tuu atu e uiga ia te ia: O loo soifua o ia!

verses.en: For we saw him, even on the right hand of God; and we heard the voice bearing record that he is the Only Begotten of the Father—
verses.sm: Auā sa ma vaai ia te ia, I le lima taumatau lava o le Atua; ma sa ma faalogo I le leo o molimau mai o ia o le Toatasi na Fanaua e le Tamā—

verses.en: That by him, and through him, and of him, the worlds are and were created, and the inhabitants thereof are begotten sons and daughters unto God.
verses.sm: E faapea e mai ia te ia, ma ala mai ia te ia, ma o ia, ua I ai lalolagi ma na foafoaina, ma o e ua nonofo ai o atalii ma afafine fanauina I le Atua.

verses.en: And this we saw also, and bear record, that an angel of God who was in authority in the presence of God, who rebelled against the Only Begotten Son whom the Father loved and who was in the bosom of the Father, was thrust down from the presence of God and the Son,
verses.sm: Ma sa ma vaai foi I le mea lenei, ma molimau ai, e I ai se agelu a le Atua o lē sa I le pule I luma o le Atua, o lē sa fouvale I le Atalii Pele e Toatasi o lē sa pele I le Tamā ma o lē sa I le finagalo o le Tamā, sa lafo ifo I lalo mai luma o le Atua ma le Alo,

w.en: to the will of the Father

verses.en: And was called Perdition, for the heavens wept over him—he was Lucifer, a son of the morning.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua o le Malaia, aua sa tutulu le lagi ona o ia— o ia o Lusifelo, o se atalii o le taeao.

verses.en: And we beheld, and lo, he is fallen! is fallen, even a son of the morning!
verses.sm: Ma sa ma vaaia, ma faauta, ua pa’ū o ia! Ua pa’ū, o se atalii lava o le taeao!

verses.en: And while we were yet in the Spirit, the Lord commanded us that we should write the vision; for we beheld Satan, that old serpent, even the devil, who rebelled against God, and sought to take the kingdom of our God and his Christ—
verses.sm: Ma a’o ma I ai pea I le Agaga, sa poloaiina I ma’ua e le Alii e tatau ona ma tusi le faaaliga vaaia; auā na ma vaaia Satani, le gata tuai lena, le tiapolo lava, o lē na fouvale faasaga I le Atua, ma saili e aveese le malo o lo tatou Atua ma lana Keriso—

verses.en: Wherefore, he maketh war with the saints of God, and encompasseth them round about.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua sii taua ai o ia i le au paia a le Atua, ma si’o faataamilo i latou.

verses.en: And we saw a vision of the sufferings of those with whom he made war and overcame, for thus came the voice of the Lord unto us:
verses.sm: Ma sa ma vaai I se faaaliga vaaia I mafatiaga o I latou o e na sii taua I ai o ia ma faatoilaloina, auā sa faapea ona oo mai o le siufofoga o le Alii ia te I ma’ua:

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord concerning all those who know my power, and have been made partakers thereof, and suffered themselves through the power of the devil to be overcome, and to deny the truth and defy my power—
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii e faatatau ia te I latou uma o e ua latou iloa lo’u mana, ma sa faia ia latou mauaina, ma ua latou tuu I latou lava ia faatoilaloina e ala I le mana o le tiapolo, ma faafitia le upumoni ma tetee I lo’u mana—

verses.en: They are they who are the sons of perdition, of whom I say that it had been better for them never to have been born;
verses.sm: O I latou ia o I latou o e o atalii o le malaia, o e Ou te fai atu ai sa sili atu mo I latou pe a na lē fananau mai;

verses.en: For they are vessels of wrath, doomed to suffer the wrath of God, with the devil and his angels in eternity;
verses.sm: Auā o I latou o ni ipu o le toasa, ua tuu-malaia e mafatia I le toasa o le Atua, faatasi ma le tiapolo ma ana agelu I le faavavau;

verses.en: Concerning whom I have said there is no forgiveness in this world nor in the world to come—
verses.sm: E faatatau lea I e na Ou fai atu ai ua leai se faamagalogaina I le lalolagi lenei po o le lalolagi a sau—

verses.en: Having denied the Holy Spirit after having received it, and having denied the Only Begotten Son of the Father, having crucified him unto themselves and put him to an open shame.
verses.sm: Ona ua latou faafitia le Agaga Paia ina ua uma ona latou mauaina, ma ona ua latou faafitia le Atalii Pele e Toatasi o le Tamā, ona ua latou faasatauroina o ia ia te I latou lava ma tuu o ia e faamaasiasia I luma o tagata.

verses.en: These are they who shall go away into the lake of fire and brimstone, with the devil and his angels—
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o le a o ese atu I le lepa afi ma le teiō, faatasi ma le tiapolo ma ana agelu—

verses.en: And the only ones on whom the second death shall have any power;
verses.sm: Ma na’o I latou ia o e o le a oo I ai I luga le mana o le oti faalua;

verses.en: Yea, verily, the only ones who shall not be redeemed in the due time of the Lord, after the sufferings of his wrath.
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni, na’o I latou lava ia o e o le a lē togiolaina I le taimi tatau ai a le Alii, pe a mavae mafatiaga o lona toasa.

verses.en: For all the rest shall be brought forth by the resurrection of the dead, through the triumph and the glory of the Lamb, who was slain, who was in the bosom of the Father before the worlds were made.
verses.sm: Auā o I latou uma e totoe o le a faatutula’I mai I le toetutū mai o e ua oti, e ala I le manumalo ma le mamalu o le Tamai Mamoe, o lē na fasia, o lē na I ai I le loto o le Tamā ae lei faia lalolagi.

verses.en: And this is the gospel, the glad tidings, which the voice out of the heavens bore record unto us—
verses.sm: Ma o le talalelei lenei, o tala fiafia ia, na molimau mai e le siufofoga mai le lagi ia te i ma’ua—

verses.en: That he came into the world, even Jesus, to be crucified for the world, and to bear the sins of the world, and to sanctify the world, and to cleanse it from all unrighteousness;
verses.sm: E faapea na afio mai o ia I le lalolagi, o Iesu lava, e faasatauroina mo le lalolagi, ma tauave agasala a le lalolagi, ma faapaia le lalolagi, ma faamamā mai amioletonu uma;

verses.en: That through him all might be saved whom the Father had put into his power and made by him;
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona faaolaina e ala ia te ia i latou uma o e na tuu e le Tamā i lona mana ma faia e ia;

verses.en: Who glorifies the Father, and saves all the works of his hands, except those sons of perdition who deny the Son after the Father has revealed him.
verses.sm: O lē ua faamamaluina le Tamā, ma laveai galuega uma a ona aao, vaganā ai atalii na o le malaia o e ua faafitia le Alo ina ua uma ona faaali mai o ia e le Tamā.

verses.en: Wherefore, he saves all except them—they shall go away into everlasting punishment, which is endless punishment, which is eternal punishment, to reign with the devil and his angels in eternity, where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched, which is their torment—
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e laveai e ia tagata uma vaganā ai I latou na— o le a latou o ese atu I le faasalaga tumau e faavavau, o le faasalaga lea e lē gata, o le faasalaga faavavau lea, e pule faatasi ma le tiapolo ma ana agelu I le faavavau, I le mea e lē mamate ai o latou īlo, ma lē mate ai le afi, o lo latou mafatiaga lea—

verses.en: And the end thereof, neither the place thereof, nor their torment, no man knows;
verses.sm: Ma o lona iuga, po o lona nofoaga, po o lo latou mafatiaga, e leai se tagata na te iloaina;

verses.en: Neither was it revealed, neither is, neither will be revealed unto man, except to them who are made partakers thereof;
verses.sm: Pe na faaali mai, pe ua faaali mai, pe o le a faaalia mai I tagata, vaganā ai ia te I latou o e o le a fai mo I latou;

verses.en: Nevertheless, I, the Lord, show it by vision unto many, but straightway shut it up again;
verses.sm: Ae ui I lea, o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te faaalia atu I le toatele I se faaaliga vaaia, ae vave ona toe tapunia;

verses.en: Wherefore, the end, the width, the height, the depth, and the misery thereof, they understand not, neither any man except those who are ordained unto this condemnation.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le i’uga, o le lautele, o le maualuga, o le loloto, ma lona pagatia, latou te lē malamalama I ai, po o soo se tagata foi vaganā ai I latou o e ua faauuina mo lenei ta’usalaga.

verses.en: And we heard the voice, saying: Write the vision, for lo, this is the end of the vision of the sufferings of the ungodly.
verses.sm: Ma sa ma faalogoina le siufofoga, ua fetalai mai: Ia tusi le faaaliga vaaia, auā faauta, o lei’uga lenei o le faaaliga vaaia e uiga I mafatiaga o e e lē amioatua.

verses.en: And again we bear record—for we saw and heard, and this is the testimony of the gospel of Christ concerning them who shall come forth in the resurrection of the just—
verses.sm: O lenei foi ma te molimau atu— ona sa ma vaai ma faalogoina, ma o le molimau lenei o le talalelei a Keriso e faatatau ia te I latou o e o le a tutula’I mai I le toetutu mai o e amiotonu—

verses.en: They are they who received the testimony of Jesus, and believed on his name and were baptized after the manner of his burial, being buried in the water in his name, and this according to the commandment which he has given—
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e na taliaina le molimau ia Iesu, ma talitonu I lona suafa ma papatiso e tusa ma le ala o lona tanuga, I le tanumia lea I totonu o le vai I lona suafa, ma e tusa lenei ma le poloaiga na tuuina mai e ia—

verses.en: That by keeping the commandments they might be washed and cleansed from all their sins, and receive the Holy Spirit by the laying on of the hands of him who is ordained and sealed unto this power;
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai, e ala I le tausia o poloaiga, ona fufuluina ma faamamāina I latou mai ia latou agasala uma, ma maua le Agaga Paia e ala I le faaee atu o lima o ia o lē ua faauuina ma faamauina I lenei mana;

verses.en: And who overcome by faith, and are sealed by the Holy Spirit of promise, which the Father sheds forth upon all those who are just and true.
verses.sm: Ma e e manumalo e ala I le faatuatua, ma ua faamauina e le Agaga Paia o le folafolaga, lea e liligi mai e le Tamā I luga o I latou uma o e amiotonu ma faamaoni.

verses.en: They are they who are the church of the Firstborn.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o le ekalesia a le Ulumatua.

verses.en: They are they into whose hands the Father has given all things—
verses.sm: O i latou ia ua tuuina atu i ai e le Tamā mea uma i o latou lima—

verses.en: They are they who are priests and kings, who have received of his fulness, and of his glory;
verses.sm: O i latou ia o e o faitaulaga ma tupu, o e ua mauaina lona atoatoa, ma lona mamalu;

verses.en: And are priests of the Most High, after the order of Melchizedek, which was after the order of Enoch, which was after the order of the Only Begotten Son.
verses.sm: Ma o faitaulaga a le Silisili Ese, e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, lea sa tusa ma le faatulagaga a Enoka, lea sa tusa ma le faatulagaga a le Atalii Pele e Toatasi.

verses.en: Wherefore, as it is written, they are gods, even the sons of God—
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e pei ona tusia, o i latou o ni atua, o atalii lava o le Atua—

verses.en: Wherefore, all things are theirs, whether life or death, or things present, or things to come, all are theirs and they are Christ's, and Christ is God's.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o mea uma e a I latou, pe o le ola po o le oti, po o mea o I ai nei, po o mea o le a oo mai, o mea uma e a I latou, ma o I latou e a Keriso, ma o Keriso e a le Atua.

verses.en: And they shall overcome all things.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou manumalo I mea uma.

verses.en: Wherefore, let no man glory in man, but rather let him glory in God, who shall subdue all enemies under his feet.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia lē tuu ai I se tagata e vivii ona o le tagata, ae ia tuu atu ia te ia e vivii ona o le Atua, o lē o le a faatoilaloina fili uma I lalo o ona aao.

verses.en: These shall dwell in the presence of God and his Christ forever and ever.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o le a nonofo I luma o le Atua ma lana Keriso e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: These are they whom he shall bring with him, when he shall come in the clouds of heaven to reign on the earth over his people.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o le a ia aumai faatasi ma ia, pe a afio mai o ia I ao o le lagi e nofotupu I le lalolagi I luga o lona nuu.

verses.en: These are they who shall have part in the first resurrection.
verses.sm: O i latou ia o e o le a mauaina se vaega i le uluai toetutu.

verses.en: These are they who shall come forth in the resurrection of the just.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o le a tutula’I mai I le toetutu mai o e amiotonu.

verses.en: These are they who are come unto Mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly place, the holiest of all.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e o mai I le Mauga o Siona, ma I le aai o le Atua soifua, le nofoaga faalelagi, e sili ona paia I aai uma.

verses.en: These are they who have come to an innumerable company of angels, to the general assembly and church of Enoch, and of the Firstborn.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e na o mai I se ’au o agelu e lē mafaitaulia, I le faapotopotoga ma le ekalesia aoao a Enoka, ma a le Ulumatua.

verses.en: These are they whose names are written in heaven, where God and Christ are the judge of all.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o o latou igoa ua tusia I le lagi, I le mea o afifio ai le Atua ma Keriso o le faamasino o tagata uma.

verses.en: These are they who are just men made perfect through Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, who wrought out this perfect atonement through the shedding of his own blood.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o tagata amiotonu ua faaatoatoaina e ala ia Iesu le puluvaga o le feagaiga fou, o lē na faia lenei togiola ua atoatoa e ala I le faamaligiina o lona lava toto.

verses.en: These are they whose bodies are celestial, whose glory is that of the sun, even the glory of God, the highest of all, whose glory the sun of the firmament is written of as being typical.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o o latou tino ua selesitila, o e o lo latou mamalu o lena o le la, le mamalu lava lea o le Atua, le silisili I tagata uma, o lē o lona mamalu ua tusia e faapea ua faatusa I le la o le vanimonimo.

verses.en: And again, we saw the terrestrial world, and behold and lo, these are they who are of the terrestrial, whose glory differs from that of the church of the Firstborn who have received the fulness of the Father, even as that of the moon differs from the sun in the firmament.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, sa ma vaai I le lalolagi terasitila, ma faauta ma tagai, o I latou ia o e ua o le terasitila, o e o lo latou mamalu ua ese mai le mamalu o le ekalesia a le Ulumatua o e ua mauaina le atoatoa o le Tamā, e pei lava ona ese le mamalu o le masina mai le la I le vanimonimo.

verses.en: Behold, these are they who died without law;
verses.sm: Faauta, o i latou ia o e na oti e aunoa ma le tulafono;

verses.en: And also they who are the spirits of men kept in prison, whom the Son visited, and preached the gospel unto them, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh;
verses.sm: Ma o I latou foi o e o agaga o tagata sa taofia I le falepuipui, o e na asia e le Alo, ma tala’I atu le talalelei ia te I latou, ina ia mafai ona faamasinoina I latou e tusa ma tagata I la le tino;

verses.en: Who received not the testimony of Jesus in the flesh, but afterwards received it.
verses.sm: O e sa lē taliaina le molimau ia Iesu i la le tino, ae mulimuli ane taliaina.

verses.en: These are they who are honorable men of the earth, who were blinded by the craftiness of men.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o tagata mamalu o le lalolagi, o e na faatauasoina I le faitogafiti o tagata.

verses.en: These are they who receive of his glory, but not of his fulness.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e maua I lona mamalu, ae lē o lona atoatoa.

verses.en: These are they who receive of the presence of the Son, but not of the fulness of the Father.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e mauaina mamalu o le Alo, ae lē o le atoatoa o le Tamā.

verses.en: Wherefore, they are bodies terrestrial, and not bodies celestial, and differ in glory as the moon differs from the sun.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o i latou o ni tagata tino terasitila, ae lē o ni tagata tino selesitila, ma e ese i le mamalu e pei ona ese le masina mai le la.

verses.en: These are they who are not valiant in the testimony of Jesus; wherefore, they obtain not the crown over the kingdom of our God.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e sa le’I totoa I le molimau ia Iesu; o le mea lea, latou te lē maua ai le pale I luga o le malo o lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: And now this is the end of the vision which we saw of the terrestrial, that the Lord commanded us to write while we were yet in the Spirit.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o le faaiuga lenei o le faaaliga vaaia o le terasitila na ma vaai I ai, lea na poloaiina I ma’ua e le Alii e tusi a’o ma’ua I ai pea I le Agaga.

verses.en: And again, we saw the glory of the telestial, which glory is that of the lesser, even as the glory of the stars differs from that of the glory of the moon in the firmament.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, sa ma vaai i le mamalu o le telesitila, le mamalu lea o le maualalo, e pei lava ona ese le mamalu o fetu mai le mamalu o le masina i le vanimonimo.

verses.en: These are they who received not the gospel of Christ, neither the testimony of Jesus.
verses.sm: O i latou ia o e sa lē taliaina le talalelei a Keriso, po o le molimau ia Iesu.

verses.en: These are they who deny not the Holy Spirit.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e ua lē faafitia le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: These are they who are thrust down to hell.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e ua lafo I lalo I seoli.

verses.en: These are they who shall not be redeemed from the devil until the last resurrection, until the Lord, even Christ the Lamb, shall have finished his work.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o le a lē togiolaina mai le tiapolo seia oo mai le toetutu mulimuli, seia mae’a ona faia e le Alii, o Keriso lava le Tamai Mamoe, lana galuega.

verses.en: These are they who receive not of his fulness in the eternal world, but of the Holy Spirit through the ministration of the terrestrial;
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e lē mauaina lona atoatoa I le lalolagi faavavau, ae o le Agaga Paia e ala atu I le auaunaga a le terasitila;

verses.en: And the terrestrial through the ministration of the celestial.
verses.sm: Ma le terasitila e ala i le auaunaga a le selesitila.

verses.en: And also the telestial receive it of the administering of angels who are appointed to minister for them, or who are appointed to be ministering spirits for them; for they shall be heirs of salvation.
verses.sm: Ma e maua foi e le telesitila mai asiasiga a agelu o e ua tofia e auauna mo I latou, po o e ua tofia e avea ma agaga auauna mo I latou; ona o le a avea I latou ma suli o le faaolataga.

verses.en: And thus we saw, in the heavenly vision, the glory of the telestial, which surpasses all understanding;
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ma vaai, i le faaaliga vaaia faalelagi, i le mamalu o le telesitila, lea ua sili mamao atu i malamalamaaga uma;

verses.en: And no man knows it except him to whom God has revealed it.
verses.sm: Ma e leai se tagata ua iloaina vaganā o ia o lē ua faaali i ai e le Atua.

verses.en: And thus we saw the glory of the terrestrial which excels in all things the glory of the telestial, even in glory, and in power, and in might, and in dominion.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ma vaai i le mamalu o le terasitila lea ua silisili atu i mea uma i le mamalu o le telesitila, i le mamalu lava, ma i le mana, ma i le malosi, ma i le pule’aga.

verses.en: And thus we saw the glory of the celestial, which excels in all things—where God, even the Father, reigns upon his throne forever and ever;
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ma vaai I le mamalu o le selesitila, lea ua silisili atu I mea uma— le mea ua nofotupu ai le Atua, le Tamā lava lea, I luga o lona nofoalii e faavavau faavavau lava;

verses.en: Before whose throne all things bow in humble reverence, and give him glory forever and ever.
verses.sm: O lē o luma o lona nofoalii e ifo atu ai mea uma I le faaaloalo lotomaualalo, ma avatu ia te ia le mamalu e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: They who dwell in his presence are the church of the Firstborn; and they see as they are seen, and know as they are known, having received of his fulness and of his grace;
verses.sm: O I latou o e e nonofo I ona luma o le ekalesia lea a le Ulumatua; ma latou te vaai e pei ona vaaia I latou, ma iloa e pei ona iloa I latou, ona ua latou maua lona atoatoa ma lona alofa tunoa;

verses.en: And he makes them equal in power, and in might, and in dominion.
verses.sm: Ma na te faia I latou ia tutusa I le mana, ma I le malosi, ma I pule’aga.

verses.en: And the glory of the celestial is one, even as the glory of the sun is one.
verses.sm: Ma o le mamalu o le selesitila ua tasi, e pei lava ona tasi le mamalu o le la.

verses.en: And the glory of the terrestrial is one, even as the glory of the moon is one.
verses.sm: Ma o le mamalu o le terasitila ua tasi, e pei lava ona tasi le mamalu o le masina.

verses.en: And the glory of the telestial is one, even as the glory of the stars is one; for as one star differs from another star in glory, even so differs one from another in glory in the telestial world;
verses.sm: Ma o le mamalu o le telesitila ua tasi, e pei lava ona tasi le mamalu o fetu; ona e pei ona ese le tasi fetu mai le isi fetu i le mamalu, ua faapea foi ona ese le tasi mai le isi i le mamalu i le lalolagi telesitila;

verses.en: For these are they who are of Paul, and of Apollos, and of Cephas.
verses.sm: Ona o i latou ia o e o lo Paulo, ma lo Apolo, ma lo Kefa.

verses.en: These are they who say they are some of one and some of another—some of Christ and some of John, and some of Moses, and some of Elias, and some of Esaias, and some of Isaiah, and some of Enoch;
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e ua fai mai o I latou o ni isi o le tasi ma ni isi o le isi— o ni isi o Keriso, ma ni isi o Ioane, ma ni isi o Mose, ma ni isi o Elaia, ma ni isi o Esaia, ma ni isi o Isaia, ma ni isi o Enoka;

verses.en: But received not the gospel, neither the testimony of Jesus, neither the prophets, neither the everlasting covenant.
verses.sm: Ae sa lē taliaina le talalelei, po o le molimau ia Iesu, po o perofeta, po o le feagaiga tumau e faavavau.

verses.en: Last of all, these all are they who will not be gathered with the saints, to be caught up unto the church of the Firstborn, and received into the cloud.
verses.sm: Mulimuli lava I mea uma, o I latou uma ia o e o le a lē faapotopotoina faatasi ma le au paia, e aveina a’e I luga I le ekalesia a le Ulumatua, ma taliaina I totonu o le ao.

verses.en: These are they who are liars, and sorcerers, and adulterers, and whoremongers, and whosoever loves and makes a lie.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e o pepelo, ma faataulaitu, ma mulilulua, ma faitaaga, ma soo se tasi e fiafia I le pepelo ma fai le pepelo.

verses.en: These are they who suffer the wrath of God on earth.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e mafatia I le toasa o le Atua I le lalolagi.

verses.en: These are they who suffer the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e mafatia I le tauimasui o le afi e faavavau.

verses.en: These are they who are cast down to hell and suffer the wrath of Almighty God, until the fulness of times, when Christ shall have subdued all enemies under his feet, and shall have perfected his work;
verses.sm: O I latou ia o e e lafo I lalo I seoli ma mafatia I le toasa o le Atua Malosi Aoao, seia oo I le atoatoaga o taimi, pe a uma ona faatoilaloina e Keriso fili uma I lalo o ona aao, ma ua uma ona faaatoatoaina e ia lana galuega;

verses.en: When he shall deliver up the kingdom, and present it unto the Father, spotless, saying: I have overcome and have trodden the wine-press alone, even the wine-press of the fierceness of the wrath of Almighty God.
verses.sm: Pe a ava’e e ia le malo, ma tuu atu I le Tamā, ua lē ponā, ma fetalai atu: Ua Ou manumalo ma ua Ou solia toatasi le soliga-vine, le soligavine lava lea o le mata’utia tele o le toasa o le Atua Malosi Aoao.

verses.en: Then shall he be crowned with the crown of his glory, to sit on the throne of his power to reign forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ona faapaleina ai lea o ia I le pale o lona mamalu, e afio I luga I le nofoalii o lona mana e nofotupu ai e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: But behold, and lo, we saw the glory and the inhabitants of the telestial world, that they were as innumerable as the stars in the firmament of heaven, or as the sand upon the seashore;
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ma tagai, sa ma vaai I le mamalu ma e e nonofo I le lalolagi telesitila, sa pei ona lē mafaitaulia I latou e pei o fetu I le vanimonimo o le lagi, po o le oneone I luga o le matafaga;

verses.en: And heard the voice of the Lord saying: These all shall bow the knee, and every tongue shall confess to him who sits upon the throne forever and ever;
verses.sm: Ma sa faalogoina le siufofoga o le Alii ua fetalai mai: O I latou uma nei o le a tootutuli tulivae, ma o le a tautino atu e laulaufaiva uma ia te ia o lē ua afio I luga o le nofoalii e faavavau ma faavavau lava;

verses.en: For they shall be judged according to their works, and every man shall receive according to his own works, his own dominion, in the mansions which are prepared;
verses.sm: Ona o le a faamasinoina i latou e tusa ma a latou galuega, ma o le a maua e tagata taitoatasi e tusa ma ana lava galuega, lana lava pule’aga, i maota ua saunia;

verses.en: And they shall be servants of the Most High; but where God and Christ dwell they cannot come, worlds without end.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea I latou ma auauna a le Silisili Ese; ae o le mea e afio ai le Atua ma Keriso, e lē mafai ona latou o atu I ai, o lalolagi e leai se iuga.

verses.en: This is the end of the vision which we saw, which we were commanded to write while we were yet in the Spirit.
verses.sm: O le faaiuga lenei o le faaaliga vaaia na ma vaai I ai, lea na poloaiina I ma’ua e tusi a’o ma I ai pea I le Agaga.

verses.en: But great and marvelous are the works of the Lord, and the mysteries of his kingdom which he showed unto us, which surpass all understanding in glory, and in might, and in dominion;
verses.sm: Ae ua maoa’e lava ma ofoofogia galuega a le Alii, ma mealilo o lona malo na faaali mai e ia ia te I ma’ua, ua silisili mamao atu I malamalamaaga uma I le mamalu, ma I le malosi, ma I le pule’aga;

verses.en: Which he commanded us we should not write while we were yet in the Spirit, and are not lawful for man to utter;
verses.sm: Ia na ia poloaiina I ma’ua e lē tatau ona ma tusia a’o ma I ai pea I le Agaga, ma ua lē faatagaina mo se tagata ia tautala I ai;

verses.en: Neither is man capable to make them known, for they are only to be seen and understood by the power of the Holy Spirit, which God bestows on those who love him, and purify themselves before him;
verses.sm: Pe mafai foi e le tagata ona faailoa atu I latou, aua ua na’o le mana lava o le Agaga Paia, lea e faaee e le Atua I luga o I latou o e e alolofa ia te ia, ma faamamā I latou lava I ona luma, e vaaia ma malamalama ai;

verses.en: To whom he grants this privilege of seeing and knowing for themselves;
verses.sm: Ia i latou e tuu atu i ai e ia lenei avanoa o le vaai ma le iloaina mo i latou lava;

verses.en: That through the power and manifestation of the Spirit, while in the flesh, they may be able to bear his presence in the world of glory.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona latou gafatia ona luma I le lalolagi o le mamalu, e ala I le mana ma faaaliga a le Agaga, a’o I ai I la le tino.

verses.en: And to God and the Lamb be glory, and honor, and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma ia i ai i le Atua ma le Tamai Mamoe le mamalu, ma le viiga, ma le pule’aga e faavavau ma faavavau lava. Amene.
